svg.title: Enchanted Meadow — editable pixel-art scene
svg.desc: Editable 864 by 1872 pixel-art meadow with the smaller corner moon and centered right tree. Small outline chips, spurs and short accidental notches have been removed while retaining deliberate pixel steps and internal detail. Eleven named layers, seven flat colors, 2-pixel grid, and vector paths only. No embedded bitmap or external asset.

g.inkscape:label: Sky and hills behind the centered tree
